description: The Cortina Mozzo is the ultimate city bike for those who want a fast, high-quality ride. It comes standard with a chain and 9-speed derailleur gears, along with Shimano hydraulic disc brakes. For an additional cost, you can opt for a belt drive, making the bike even more low-maintenance. Weighing only 17 kg, it's incredibly lightweight. The frame features a distinctive design and is available in a range of stylish colors. You're good to go!
